lines.text: Sidon, the stronghold of the sea, must be ashamed, and Egypt will writhe in agony over Tyre.
The LORD of Hosts planned this to disgrace the renowned, and Tarshish's daughter has no harbor.
The Virgin Daughter of Sidon will rejoice no more, and the Philistines ruined the land of the Chaldeans.
Tyre will be forgotten for forty years, but the LORD will restore her and set her profits apart.
